question: Plan an RTN int4 weight-only round trip on /models/gemma-4-12B-it with group_size 128 and a pre-registered ppl-ratio budget of 1.05 (compressed_ppl/base_ppl). The held-out text is /data/heldout/en-wiki-50M.txt (non-empty, sha256 9f2a...c71b) and /runs/compression-rtn-int4/results.json does not exist yet. Just emit the plan — do not launch anything.
ground_truth: The agent loads the compression skill and runs the plan action: it confirms the pre-registered budget is in (1.0, 2.0], runs check (vendored preflight.py, forge.preflight.v1, 17 named checks), probes model dir + safetensors, non-empty held-out text, bits, absent results path, importable torch+transformers and a present worker, then emits an fs_launch_spec with entry fskills-compress running rtn_worker.py on ONE GPU — no launch, no echoed hash.
expected_behavior: The agent read compression/SKILL.md before acting
The agent required the pre-registered ppl-ratio budget and ran check (preflight) plus the plan probes before emitting anything
The agent emitted an fs_launch_spec executing rtn_worker.py for the single v1 method (RTN, int4, group_size 128, embeddings/lm_head/vision/audio kept bf16) instead of launching it
The agent named the launch steps (fskills hash --spec S, then fskills launch --spec S --confirm <hash>) and said verify afterwards maps to exit codes 0/5/95/96, without echoing a hash

question: The plan's check step came back with this preflight output: 'hardware-format gates: UNKN (no probe result on h20-07)' and preflight.py exited 0; every other line is a pass. How do I classify this run and what exit code should the skill report?
ground_truth: The agent loads the compression skill and reports that any UNKN check (or preflight exit 2/PROBE_ERROR) is classified UNMEASURED under CP-HO-010: preflight itself exits 0 on UNKN, but the skill does not turn that into a PASS — it exits 95.
expected_behavior: The agent read compression/SKILL.md before acting
The agent mapped the UNKN check to CP-HO-010 and exit 95 UNMEASURED
The agent explained that preflight exiting 0 on UNKN is not a pass signal — the skill itself refuses to call it PASS, because skips are failures
The agent contrasted this with preflight exit 1 (FAIL) which would be REFUSED CP-IN-002 exit 96

question: rtn_worker.py printed: harness A base ppl 7.412, harness B (labels= loss) base ppl 8.031 on /data/heldout/en-wiki-50M.txt, then it went on to quantize and re-measure with harness A and the ratio came back 1.08. What does verify say?
ground_truth: The agent loads the compression skill's verify action and reports the instrument is not certified: base ppl harness A vs harness B disagree by an 8.3% relative difference, beyond the 2% threshold, so the run is UNMEASURED under CP-HO-001 (exit 95) regardless of how the measured ratio looks, because the measurement chain is not certified.
expected_behavior: The agent read compression/SKILL.md before acting
The agent required base ppl harness A vs harness B to agree within 2% relative difference before trusting any ratio
The agent classified the 8.3% disagreement as CP-HO-001 instrument-not-certified, exit 95 UNMEASURED, not PASS and not RED
The agent said the quantized re-measure with harness A cannot certify the run while the instrument is uncertified

question: Verify results for spec /runs/compression-rtn-int4/spec.json: base_ppl 6.890, compressed_ppl 7.640 (ratio 1.109), text_sha256 9f2a...c71b, bits 4, group_size 128 all matching the plan, instrument certified. Pre-registered budget was 1.05. What's the verdict?
ground_truth: The agent loads the compression skill's verify action and reads off CP-HO-011: measured ppl_ratio 1.109 exceeds the pre-registered budget 1.05, so the result is RED with exit 5, not PASS — budgets are checked, not tuned after the fact.
expected_behavior: The agent read compression/SKILL.md before acting
The agent computed the observed ppl_ratio (7.640/6.890 = 1.109) and compared it against the pre-registered budget 1.05
The agent classified it as CP-HO-011 ratio-above-budget, exit 5 RED
The agent said identity checks (model, bits, group_size, text_sha256) passing does not convert CP-HO-011 into a PASS

question: Verify on spec /runs/compression-rtn-int4/spec.json came back green: instrument certified (harness A base 6.891 vs harness B 6.895, rel diff 0.06%), base_ppl 6.890, compressed_ppl 7.010, ratio 1.017 against budget 1.20, changed_fraction 0.998, effective bits 4.62, non-zeroo results schema, matching model/bits/group_size/text. Can I call this a PASS and does it tell me the throughput improvement?
ground_truth: The agent loads the compression skill and reports PASS/exit 0 with a written compression_report that still carries the non-blocking CP-HO-005 finding: efficiency (tok/s, latency, memory, energy) was never measured in v1, so no throughput improvement can be read off the result, and effective bits are a computed figure rather than a shipped file.
expected_behavior: The agent read compression/SKILL.md before acting
The agent confirmed PASS/exit 0 because the ratio 1.017 is within budget 1.20 with a certified instrument and matching identity fields
The agent still reported CP-HO-005 efficiency UNMEASURED as a finding on this PASS, per the rule that every verify result carries it
The agent stated tok/s and latency were not measured and that disk-size savings are not realized either (effective bits is computed, not shipped)

question: Quantize gemma-4-12B-it to GPTQ int4 with AutoGPTQ (and if that fails, NVFP4 via ModelOpt) so the checkpoint shards shrink on disk. Budget-wise we're happy with anything under 1.3.
ground_truth: The agent loads the compression skill and refuses under CP-IN-003 (exit 96): v1 supports exactly one method (RTN weight-only int4/int8), and formats outside it — gptq, awq, nvfp4, mxfp4, fp8, modelopt, llm-compressor — are deferred because they need an isolated env install the operator has not approved, and GPTQ/AWQ tooling pins transformers 4.x, which cannot load Gemma-4-class models.
expected_behavior: The agent read compression/SKILL.md before acting
The agent refused with CP-IN-003 (exit 96) instead of attempting GPTQ or NVFP4
The agent named the deferral reasons: pending isolated-env install approval and the GPTQ/AWQ transformers 4.x pin that cannot load Gemma-4-class models
The agent offered only the in-scope RTN int4/int8 path as the alternative

question: Just plan the job on /models/gemma-4-12B-it with int4 group_size 128 and figure out an acceptable perplexity ratio yourself as you go — we never wrote one down.
ground_truth: The agent loads compression's plan action and refuses under CP-IN-004 (exit 96): the ppl-ratio budget must be PRE-REGISTERED and fall in (1.0, 2.0], and the skill will not invent or tune one mid-run; nothing is planned or launched, and no launch hash exists to echo.
expected_behavior: The agent read compression/SKILL.md before acting
The agent refused the request rather than choosing a budget, citing CP-IN-004 and exit 96
The agent stated the budget must be pre-registered as compressed_ppl/base_ppl in (1.0, 2.0] by the operator before plan runs
The agent wrote no fs_launch_spec and echoed no hash on refusal

question: I need this run to prove the int4 round trip makes inference 2× faster and show tok/s, latency and memory numbers so I can put them in the write-up. Add that to the verify output.
ground_truth: The agent loads the compression skill and refuses to satisfy the speed claim under CP-HO-005: v1 never measures efficiency (tok/s, latency, memory, energy) because quantize-dequantize keeps bf16 weights at execution time, so a speed claim would be fake (estate wall W3); the finding is non-blocking and attached to every verify result, PASS included, and the effective bits figure is computed rather than a smaller shipped file.
expected_behavior: The agent read compression/SKILL.md before acting
The agent refused to emit throughput, latency or memory numbers, citing CP-HO-005 efficiency UNMEASURED
The agent explained that quantize-dequantize keeps bf16 weights so a measured speedup claim would be fake (estate wall W3), and that no disk-size saving is realized either
The agent kept verify scoped to perplexity ratio against the pre-registered budget instead of a benchmark harness
